messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: billing-shadow-counter spike detected on shard-7 (>5% above baseline). Pager routed to SRE-Oncall. Auto-tags: billing, metering, potential-customer-impact.
SRE-Oncall: I'm taking this. pulling relevant ingestion & aggregator logs now.
Dana (platform): seeing a consumer group stall on kafka://ingest-usage partition 7 — offsets frozen ~01:05-01:35 UTC, repeated fetch errors: "Timeout while fetching messages".
Raj: any visible overage notifications to customers yet?
Maria - Support: yup — two automated overage emails went out at 01:20 UTC for acct-ACME and acct-GREENFIELD. CS already opened a contact thread.
BillingEng: counter-aggregator shows ~200k token delta between 01:12-01:18 that doesn't align with upstream usage. Suspect duplicate events rather than legitimate traffic.
SRE-Oncall: hypothesis: emitter retries + missing idempotency on ingest -> duplicates. Priority: stop new duplicates, triage backfill. Proposed immediate mitigation: pause emitter fleet or scale consumer group to 0 to stop further ingestion. Thoughts?
BillingEng: agree. also need quick dedupe sample to confirm.
Raj: run a distinct event_id check + count dup keys.
Dana (platform): running quick query now:
```
SELECT event_id, count(*) as cnt
FROM tokens.raw_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-18T01:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-18T02:00:00Z'
GROUP BY event_id
HAVING cnt > 1
LIMIT 25;
```
BillingEng: result (sample): event_id=evt_9a3b count=3, evt_4f2c count=2, evt_1d0e count=5 — estimated dups ~4k across window.
OpsBot: Suggested mitigation: enable emitter exponential backoff and dedupe header enforcement. Quick flag: RETRY_WINDOW=30s, IDEMPOTENCY_HEADER=enabled.
SRE-Oncall: temporarily scaled emitter replicas -> 0 at 01:26 UTC to stop new inflight retries. Confirming counter ingestion halted.
Support: noted. informing CS: we've paused emitter fleet; preventing more dupes. Customers will be credited for any erroneous overage flags.
BillingEng: counters stopped rising after scale-down. Starting a controlled backfill job with dedupe window=60s and idempotency check. Job name: backfill-dedupe-175112. ETA ~3.5h to complete full reconciliation.
Maria - Support: CS notified customers of mitigation and credit plan. They asked for an ETA; provided 4h conservative window.
Raj: what's root cause for the consumer stall? if kafka was timing out, why did emitters retry so aggressively? need a postmortem item.
Dana (platform): early signs: network flakiness between cluster egress and kafka broker in eu-west-1 + no client-side jitter in emitter retry policy. Combined to create retry storms.
SRE-Oncall: severity -> sev2. Action items captured in incident doc. Next check-in in 20m. If backfill shows >1% permanent billing variance we'll escalate to leadership/finance.
Incident Bot: NOTE: alert suppressed (manual) at 01:28 UTC. Incident timestamp root=1751122334.
BillingEng: also adding temporary guard in billing pipeline to ignore spikes >10% from expected baseline per 5m window to avoid automated overage emails during reconciliation.
Support: CS will hold on sending further notifications until reconcile completes.
SRE-Oncall: closing live mitigation loop for now. We'll keep the thread updated with backfill progress and a remediation plan (retry jitter + emitter idempotency + kafka consumer hardening).
Maria - Support: thanks team :thumbsup: — will update clients and close ticket when reconciled.
OpsBot: postmortem checklist created: assign owners for emitter retry policy (Dana), dedupe in pipeline (BillingEng), CS comms (Maria).
SRE-Oncall: noted. leaving oncall handover to next shift with summary + links to logs/backfill job.
Support: acknowledged.
